subtopics.label: Dysphagia Assessment and Swallowing Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on the evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment of swallowing disorders, including FEES and VFSS methodologies, respiratory-swallow coordination, pharyngeal residue quantification, and swallowing rehabilitation in neurogenic and other dysphagic populations.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment of swallowing disorders across neurogenic and dysphagic populations.

subtopics.label: Voice Disorders, Vocal Fold Pathology, and Laryngology
subtopics.description: Research on vocal fold lesions, voice disorders, laryngoscopic evaluation, phonosurgery outcomes, and voice rehabilitation including phonotraumatic lesions, vocal fold paralysis, hemorrhage, and gender-affirming voice modification.
subtopics.short_description: Vocal fold lesions, phonosurgery outcomes, and voice rehabilitation including paralysis and gender-affirming modification.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Imaging in Laryngoscopy and Head and Neck Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research applying artificial intelligence, deep learning, and advanced imaging techniques to laryngoscopy, vocal fold pathology classification, head and neck cancer imaging, and clinical decision support in otolaryngology.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning and advanced imaging for vocal fold classification, head and neck cancer diagnostics, and clinical decision support.

subtopics.label: Head and Neck Cancer: Oral Cavity, Oropharynx, and Squamous Cell Carcinoma
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, molecular biology, staging, surgical management, and outcomes of oral cavity and oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas, including depth of invasion, nodal metastasis, and prognostic factors.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, molecular biology, staging, and surgical outcomes of oral and oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas.

subtopics.label: Thyroid and Parathyroid Surgery and Pathology
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management, outcomes, and pathology of thyroid and parathyroid conditions, including thyroidectomy complications, thyroid cancer prognosis, hormone replacement, and access to high-volume centers.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management, complications, and prognosis of thyroid and parathyroid conditions including access to high-volume centers.

subtopics.label: Facial Fractures and Craniofacial Trauma
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, management, and cost burden of facial fractures including zygoma, mandible, and frontal sinus fractures, with analysis of injury patterns, treatment trends, and outcomes in urban trauma settings.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, management, and cost burden of facial fractures including zygoma, mandible, and frontal sinus injuries.

subtopics.label: Rhinology, Sinusitis, and Sinonasal Conditions
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, management, and surgical treatment of rhinosinusitis and sinonasal conditions, including chronic rhinosinusitis guidelines adherence, balloon sinuplasty, sinonasal complications, and pediatric rhinosinusitis microbiome.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, management, and surgical treatment of rhinosinusitis including balloon sinuplasty and pediatric sinonasal microbiome.

subtopics.label: Hearing Loss, Audiology, and Vestibular Schwannoma
subtopics.description: Research on hearing loss epidemiology, audiologic outcomes, cochlear implantation, vestibular schwannoma management, and the psychosocial and functional impacts of hearing impairment across the lifespan.
subtopics.short_description: Audiologic outcomes, cochlear implantation, vestibular schwannoma management, and psychosocial impacts of hearing impairment.

subtopics.label: Laryngoscopy Simulation, Surgical Training, and Low-Cost Devices
subtopics.description: Research on simulation-based surgical training tools, 3D-printed laryngeal and thyroplasty simulators, low-cost laryngoscope design, and assessment of procedural skills in laryngology and otolaryngology education.
subtopics.short_description: 3D-printed simulators, low-cost laryngoscope design, and procedural skills assessment in laryngology education.

subtopics.label: Cough Assessment, Airway Protection, and Respiratory Muscle Strength
subtopics.description: Research on objective and auditory-perceptual assessment of cough, respiratory muscle strength measurement tools, cough as a dysphagia screening modality, and airway protective responses in neurological and dysphagic populations.
subtopics.short_description: Objective and perceptual cough evaluation, respiratory muscle strength tools, and airway protective responses in neurological populations.

subtopics.label: Cartilage Tissue Engineering and Auricular Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Research on bioengineering approaches to auricular and nasal cartilage reconstruction, including decellularized xenograft scaffolds, 3D-printed external scaffolds, mesenchymal stem cell chaperoning, and in vivo implant studies.
subtopics.short_description: Bioengineered scaffolds, stem cell approaches, and 3D-printed implants for auricular and nasal cartilage reconstruction.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Airway, Aerodigestive Disorders, and Tracheostomy
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric aerodigestive conditions including chronic aspiration, recurrent croup, ankyloglossia, obstructive sleep apnea in infants, tympanostomy tube placement, and tracheostomy care and education.
subtopics.short_description: Chronic aspiration, ankyloglossia, pediatric sleep apnea, tympanostomy, and tracheostomy care in children.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Disparities, Access to Care, and Health Policy in Otolaryngology
subtopics.description: Research examining disparities in access to otolaryngologic care, including the effects of insurance status, the Affordable Care Act, telemedicine, and socioeconomic factors on outcomes and utilization across head and neck conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Insurance status, telemedicine, and socioeconomic factors affecting outcomes and utilization across head and neck conditions.

subtopics.label: Salivary Gland Pathology and Parotid Tumors
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, imaging, and management of salivary gland disorders including parotid pleomorphic adenoma, acinic cell carcinoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma, and sialendoscopy for chronic sialadenitis.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and management of parotid tumors, adenoid cystic carcinoma, and sialendoscopy for chronic sialadenitis.

subtopics.label: Peripheral Nerve Decompression and Surgical Treatment of Headache and Neuralgia
subtopics.description: Research on surgical decompression of peripheral nerves (occipital, trigeminal, and related) for treatment of chronic headaches, migraines, and neuralgias, including outcomes, timing, and nerve reconstruction techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical decompression of occipital and trigeminal nerves for chronic migraines, headaches, and neuralgias.

subtopics.label: Skull Base Surgery: Endoscopic, Endonasal, and Open Approaches
subtopics.description: Studies examining surgical approaches to the skull base including endonasal endoscopic routes to the craniovertebral junction, cavernous sinus, petrous apex, and related structures, with emphasis on technique and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Endonasal and open surgical approaches to the craniovertebral junction, cavernous sinus, and petrous apex.

subtopics.label: Post-Anti-Reflux Surgery Dysphagia and Esophageal Motility
subtopics.description: Research investigating dysphagia and esophageal motility disorders following anti-reflux and hiatal hernia repair surgeries, including endoscopic balloon dilation, planimetry-based assessment, and outcomes of Linx and robotic procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Esophageal motility disorders and dysphagia following hiatal hernia repair, Linx, and robotic anti-reflux procedures.

subtopics.label: Surgical Ergonomics, Workforce Well-Being, and Burnout in Otolaryngology
subtopics.description: Studies examining musculoskeletal strain, ergonomic challenges, and professional burnout among otolaryngologists, with particular focus on gender-specific ergonomic issues and factors affecting professional fulfillment.
subtopics.short_description: Musculoskeletal strain, burnout, and gender-specific ergonomic challenges among otolaryngology surgeons.

subtopics.label: Rhinoplasty, Nasal Reconstruction, and Implant Materials
subtopics.description: Research on surgical techniques and materials for nasal reconstruction and augmentation rhinoplasty, including nasal tip delamination techniques and biocompatible polylactic acid scaffold implants.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical techniques and biocompatible implant materials for nasal reconstruction and augmentation rhinoplasty.

subtopics.label: Chiari Malformation and Craniocervical Junction Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical management of Chiari malformation and craniocervical junction pathology, including revision surgery predictors in children, intraoperative alignment optimization, and occipitocervical fusion outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of Chiari malformation and craniocervical junction pathology including revision predictors and fusion outcomes.

subtopics.label: Nerve Injury Imaging, Neurography, and Facial Nerve Palsy
subtopics.description: Research on diagnostic imaging and biomarker approaches for head and neck nerve injuries, including magnetic resonance neurography for sensory nerve injuries and cerebrospinal fluid proteomics in idiopathic facial nerve palsy.
subtopics.display_name: Nerve Injury Imaging & Facial Nerve Palsy
subtopics.short_description: MR neurography for sensory nerve injuries and CSF proteomics in idiopathic facial nerve palsy diagnosis.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Impact on Otolaryngology Practice and Pediatric Presentations
subtopics.description: Studies examining the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on otolaryngology clinical practice, inpatient consultation patterns, pediatric surgical screening, and COVID-19-related pediatric airway presentations such as croup during the Omicron wave.
subtopics.short_description: Pandemic effects on clinical practice, consultation patterns, and pediatric airway presentations including Omicron-related croup.

subtopics.label: Head and Neck Reconstruction and Microsurgery in Special Populations
subtopics.description: Research on microsurgical and reconstructive approaches for head and neck defects in complex patient populations, including immunocompromised patients, transplant recipients, and those with rare syndromes such as Fanconi anemia.
subtopics.short_description: Reconstructive and microsurgical approaches for head and neck defects in immunocompromised and transplant populations.

subtopics.label: Sinonasal Papilloma and Benign Sinonasal Tumors
subtopics.description: Studies on the clinical behavior, histologic subtypes, and outcomes of sinonasal papillomas including inverted and combined exophytic-inverted papilloma subtypes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical behavior, histologic subtypes, and outcomes of inverted and exophytic sinonasal papillomas.

subtopics.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea: Oral Appliance and Non-CPAP Therapies
subtopics.description: Research evaluating mandibular advancement devices and other non-CPAP oral appliance therapies for obstructive sleep apnea, including efficacy, effectiveness, and patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Efficacy and outcomes of mandibular advancement devices and oral appliance therapies for obstructive sleep apnea.
